scenes.title: 3 things to know before buying XGODY
scenes.say: Thinking about an XGODY GPS? Three things to know first.

scenes.title: Short and defect-only
scenes.say: One. The warranty is short. Refunds within fourteen days for defects, replacement up to thirty days, and free repair only up to a hundred and eighty days.

scenes.title: Store vs Trustpilot
scenes.say: Two. Sat navs show four to nearly five stars on XGODY's store, but Trustpilot shows one point four from a hundred twenty five reviews, mostly about failures and warranty claims.

scenes.title: Free updates, but manual
scenes.say: Three. Map updates are free for life, but you get a download link by email and copy the files yourself with a computer.

scenes.title: Cheap big screens, mind the risk
scenes.say: The good part: sat navs with truck routing from seventy one ninety nine. Pay with buyer protection and use code TRANTRUNG for ten percent off. Full review on WiseChoice K R dot com.
